name: TensorProduct.Algebra.eq_of_fg_of_subtype_eq
statement: rTensor N A.val.toLinearMap t = rTensor N A.val.toLinearMap t') : ∃ (B : Subalgebra R S) (hAB : A ≤ B), Subalgebra.FG B ∧ rTensor N (Subalgebra.inclusion hAB).toLinearMap t = LinearMap.rTensor N (Subalgebra.inclusion hAB).toLinearMap t'

name: Submodule.exists_fg_of_baseChange_eq_zero
statement: M →ₗ[R] N) {t : S ⊗[R] M} (ht : f.baseChange S t = 0) : ∃ (A : Subalgebra R S) (_ : A.FG) (u : A ⊗[R] M), f.baseChange A u = 0 ∧ A.val.toLinearMap.rTensor M u = t
